# Flayr

## About
Flayr is an AI-powered ad creative platform that uses competitor intelligence to generate TikTok and Meta ads. Founded in 2026 by Andrew Cruz.

## What Flayr Does
Flayr scrapes TikTok Ad Library to find competitors' best-performing ads, extracts the winning hook formulas, structures, and CTAs, then generates photo ads, UGC videos, reaction videos, and slideshows built on those proven formulas.

## Key Features
- Competitor ad intelligence (TikTok Ad Library analysis)
- AI photo ad generation (GPT Image)
- AI UGC video generation (Seedance 2.0)
- Weekly automated creative drops
- One-click Meta and TikTok campaign launch
- Campaign performance tracking and optimization
- Built-in video and photo editor

## Pricing
- Solo: $49.99/month (1 brand, 100 credits, 2 weekly drop ads)
- Scale: $149.99/month (3 brands, 300 credits, 5 weekly drop ads)
- 5-day free trial, no credit card required

## Target Users
DTC ecommerce founders and brands running paid ads on Meta and TikTok who need ad creative but cannot afford a creative agency.
